scope: Apply explicit owner-directed removal of aggregate journal byte ceilings across existing writers, preserve all safety policies, and report nonblocking provider request utilization.
riskAnalysis: Intentional owner storage-policy change, not an increase in spending or access. Provider errors may stop storage or cleanup; existing finite task expiry, guards and uncertainty accounting remain fail-closed. No new arbitrary storage cutoff replaces the old one. Request telemetry is an estimate, not account-specific quota verification.

threatModel.assets: Immutable audit history, task authority, credentials, spending and cross-workspace isolation.
threatModel.trustBoundaries: Owner authorization precedes read-only projection; all mutations retain existing CAS, runtime and task checks.
threatModel.abuseCases: History overwrite, cross-workspace writes, authorization bypass, false paid readiness or concealed provider write failure.
threatModel.mitigations: Owner/workspace isolation, source binding, per-field bounds, spending, expiry, cancellation, role separation and atomic CAS remain. Application CAS propagates thrown exceptions. SDK network retry policy is unchanged. Telemetry exposes numeric sizes only.

rollback: Revert reviewed application code to prior paid-disabled Preview if qualification fails. Never roll back/delete persisted history or revive old grants; restored lower caps could reject larger current records.

negativePaths.malformed-response: Capacity rejects non-array registry state, and unchanged inference parser remains authoritative.
negativePaths.stale-state: Existing task/runtime checks and CAS readback remain required.
negativePaths.concurrency: Real CAS conflict test retains concurrent historical row and appends once.
negativePaths.cancellation: Existing revocation bypasses new admission checks and retains earlier cleanup fallback.
negativePaths.worker-interruption: No worker execution changes. Expiry and authority guards fail closed; diagnostics/revocation may write beyond removed application caps, subject to actual provider availability.
negativePaths.api-outage: Synthetic thrown adapter exception is attempted once at the application CAS layer with unchanged durable state; existing SDK network retries remain separate and are not claimed disabled.
negativePaths.authorization-denial: Existing owner-before-read test and exact source task checks remain unchanged.
negativePaths.spending-limit: No budget change or new paid request. Actual provider write failures stop the workflow and retain financial uncertainty.
negativePaths.partial-execution: Diagnostics and revocation remain permitted beyond former bytecaps; actual provider failures propagate, never become successful cleanup receipts.

defects.rootCause: Self-imposed aggregate journal ceilings blocked authorized engineering despite substantially higher documented provider request limits.
defects.detectionGap: Multiple existing writers independently enforced historical aggregate byte thresholds, so removing only one would leave hidden blockers.
defects.regression: Large legacy/shared/Operations/configuration records preserve history; provider failure is not retried; realRedis exercises large CAS.
defects.historicalPrevention: Provider-only storage policy and owner-visible bytes/request estimate distinguish real service boundaries from internal authorization limits.

proactiveReview.architecture: Keep the existing shared Redis CAS and separate Operations key; no segmentation, journal duplication, archive or orchestration change.
proactiveReview.dependencies: No package, lockfile, external service, worker or build-policy changes. New pure module fingerprint-bound.
proactiveReview.threats: Uncontrolled field data, permission escalation, provider rejection or inaccurate cleanup claims remain prevented by unchanged validators and fail-closed transitions.
proactiveReview.failureModes: Domain-count and authority guards fail closed. Provider errors propagate; no aggregate application byte guard or byte reserve remains. Actual provider rejection may prevent durable cleanup writes.
proactiveReview.faultInjection: Oversized relative-to-old-cap history, escaped values, actual registry denial, provider errors and stale/concurrent CAS are exercised without paid calls.
proactiveReview.independentChallenge: Separate Work QA and Engineering Auditor reviewed removal under explicit owner direction. No material source finding; application CAS retry behavior is distinct from unchanged SDK network retries.
proactiveReview.recovery: Keep old claimed configuration and all historical evidence intact until reviewed cancellation; never retry refresh blindly.
proactiveReview.readiness: Focused tests and independent source review precede STRICT and exact paid-disabled Preview qualification; no paid activation inferred.
